dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| extend TimeGenerated= requestTime, EventStartTime= requestTime, EventEndTime= requestTime
 | project-rename EventType= activityAction,  DvcIpAddr=ipAddress, DvcDescription=deviceType, EventOriginalUid= taskId, Operation= taskDisplayName, ActorUsername= systemAccount, ActorSessionId=sessionId, HttpUserAgent= userAgent
 | extend Object= tostring(target.descriptor), TargetAppId= tostring(target.id), TargetUrl= tostring(target.href), EventCount= toint(1), EventSchema= "AuditEvent", EventResult= "NA", EventProduct="Workday", EventVendor="Workday", EventSchemaVersion="0.1",ObjectType="Other", Dvc=DvcIpAddr | extend EventType = case(EventType == "READ","Read", EventType == "WRITE","Set", "Other")
| project-away requestTime, target, EventSchema, Dvc
